rules.description: Applicant must have reached State Pension age
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have reached State Pension age to qualify for Pension Credit. Check when you'll reach State Pension age.

rules.description: Applicant must live in England, Scotland or Wales
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is for residents of England, Scotland and Wales only. Northern Ireland has a separate Pension Credit service.

rules.description: EU/EEA/Swiss citizens must have settled or pre-settled status
rules.reason_if_failed: If you're from the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein, you need settled or pre-settled status under the EU Settlement Scheme.

rules.description: Weekly income below threshold (£227.10 single, £346.60 couple) or has qualifying circumstances
rules.reason_if_failed: Your income may be too high for Pension Credit, but you might still qualify if you have a disability, care for someone, have savings or have housing costs.

rules.description: Neither applicant nor partner can be getting Universal Credit
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot get Pension Credit and Universal Credit at the same time. If you or your partner gets Universal Credit, you're not eligible for Pension Credit.

explanation_template: Pension Credit eligibility: {outcome}. Estimated weekly top-up: £{amount}

edge_cases.description: Partner is under State Pension age
edge_cases.action: Complex eligibility rules apply. If relationship started after 15 May 2019, not eligible for Pension Credit (route to Universal Credit). If before and already claiming, may continue. Requires human assessment.

edge_cases.description: Applicant in care home for more than 4 weeks
edge_cases.action: Different calculation rules apply. Must report funding changes. Requires assessment of care home fees, NHS/council funding, and residency status.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has an Assessed Income Period (AIP) - aged 75+ and started claiming before 6 April 2016
edge_cases.action: Different reporting requirements. Applicant does not need to report changes to pensions, savings or investments unless AIP ends due to household change.
Can continue for up to 4 weeks (or 8 weeks for bereavement, or 26 weeks for medical treatment). Must notify Pension Service before leaving. Cannot apply while already abroad.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has deferred State Pension or private pension entitlement
edge_cases.action: Notional income applied. Expected pension amount counts as income even if not being claimed. Cannot build up extra State Pension deferral while on Pension Credit.

edge_cases.description: Applicant reached State Pension age before 6 April 2016 and may qualify for Savings Credit only
edge_cases.action: May be eligible for Savings Credit even if income too high for Guarantee Credit. Up to £17.30/week single, £19.36/week couple. Requires separate assessment.
